Webmaster;"Announcement";"Warning about spam emails";"Dear members of the ESTS
There have recently been emails purportedly sent by Vera Fischer in connection with activities of the ESTS
column2: trying to make contact with members of the set theory community and asking you to reply. The goal of these emails is likely to eventually obtain private information from you or trick you into payments if you reply.

column1: - do not give any personal information to the senders of such emails
- carefully check the sender of such emails and report the emails as spam with your email service
- we're happy if you can forward us a copy of such spam emails to european.set.theory@gmail.com
column2: or email us there if you are in doubt

column1: All emails from the ESTS to its members
column3: are sent exclusively from european.set.theory@gmail.com. We will never ask you for personal information. The only information we keep about members are name
column4: email address and whether you are a student.
